status_reason: Scoped Phase 05 objective met: socket-side coalescing normalizes the request ACK mode SEPARATE->COMBINED on the wire where the responding socket is controlled, without modifying DNP3 response bytes (full logical responses -- all single-segment, verified), without dropping packets, and without destabilizing TCP; the effect on device-profile classification is evaluated on defended wire captures (single-server demo, per-profile loopback eval, and a two-host Vision<->Hulk replay eval). Out-of-scope items (physical target-device testing, inline suppression for uncontrolled sockets, Tofino, response-size padding) are deferred/separate lines, NOT Phase 05 blockers.

environment.rig: Vision(10.10.54.19) master <-> Hulk(10.10.54.158) outstation, 1G mgmt net, non-sudo capture

classifier.split: capture-level, leakage-safe (train base pcap, test disjoint L pcap)

response_reconstruction_audit.note: Every selected response is a single TCP payload segment, so the replayed first-segment bytes ARE the complete logical DNP3 response; full-response-byte and response-size claims are valid. The extractor reconstructs the full logical response across segments in the general case (unit-tested). Detail: response_reconstruction_audit.csv.
response_reconstruction_audit.conclusion_size_residual: ION7550 responses are 61 B (distinct); SEL-751 and AB1400 are 54 B (shared) -> ION7550 is size-identifiable and SEL-751<->AB1400 collapse once the ACK mode is removed.

feature_decomposition.note: The former 'ack_only' family mixed categorical packet structure with ACK timing; renamed 'ack_combined' and decomposed. Balanced accuracy == raw accuracy (balanced test classes). mode_only after coalescing is a zero-variance constant feature -> reported non-discriminating (majority baseline), not a learned score.

all.coalesced_edt: 0.322 (unstable: loopback timing-normalization jitter across captures; rig is the authoritative joint measurement)

trace_transformation_rf_accuracy_support.note: n=11494 native transactions, imbalanced classes, chance 0.400; software transform, not defended-wire

wire_integrity.loopback: separate-ACK fraction SEL 1.00->0.00 (coalesced); byte-identical 720/720 per condition (2160/2160); 0 retransmissions / 0 resets / 0 duplicate ACKs across 714 non-first txns/condition; resets: none within established replay sessions.
wire_integrity.two_host_rig: client 2160/2160 byte-identical; SEL separate-ACK 1.00->0.00; 18/18 streams mapped; 0 retransmissions / 0 resets / 0 duplicate ACKs across 714 non-first txns/condition on real NICs.

central_result: Socket coalescing removes the categorical request-ACK-mode feature on the captured wire (mode_only 0.667 native -> 0.333 constant/non-discriminating coalesced). Residual classification is attributable to timing variation and response size, with response size the dominant stable residual in the evaluated feature set (ION7550 61 B stays identifiable; SEL-751<->AB1400 collapse). Full device anonymity is not achieved. Clock-skew and higher-order timing distributions were not exhaustively ruled out.
supported_claims: Socket-side coalescing normalizes the request ACK mode SEPARATE->COMBINED on the wire (single-server demo, per-profile loopback eval, and two-host Vision<->Hulk replay eval); is_separate 1.00->0.00, byte-preserving, no dropped packets.

Response bytes are preserved at the correct logical-response scope: every selected response is single-segment (720/720), so replayed first-segment bytes are the complete logical response (source hash == replay hash).
mode_only (categorical ACK mode) is removed by coalescing: 0.667 native -> constant/non-discriminating after coalescing on both loopback and rig.
Response size is the dominant stable residual (ION7550 61 B identifiable; SEL-751<->AB1400 confusable); joint 'all' does not reach baseline because size leaks.
Transport health is clean on loopback and on real two-host NICs (0 retransmissions / resets / duplicate ACKs within established sessions).
unsupported_claims: Full device anonymity -- response size still separates ION7550.
That response size is the ONLY possible residual -- TCP-timestamp clock-skew and higher-order timing-distribution features were not exhaustively evaluated.
A physical SEL-751/AB1400/ION7550 result -- all evaluations reproduce device-derived profiles; the three physical target devices are not on this rig.
Safety of inline suppression for sockets we do not control -- a separate, unbuilt mechanism.
scoped_limitations_not_blockers: physical SEL-751 / AB1400 / ION7550 validation (deferred external validation)
inline predictive ACK suppression for uncontrolled sockets (separate deployment mechanism)
TCP-timestamp clock-skew analysis and broader timing-distribution matching
